# NQL parser golden corpus

The **parse-level oracle** for the nql front-end (spec/nql.md §1 grammar),
consumed by nqlite-zig's M2 parser port: parse each `source`, reproduce the
statements **byte-for-bit**, and fail with the same error *kind* at the same
`line:col` (or the same analyzer variant).

Generated by the Rust front-end — `nql/tests/parser_corpus.rs` — from
`nql::parse` / `nql::parse_statement` + `Analyzer::analyze`.
**Never hand-edit.** Regenerate only alongside a deliberate grammar change
(and its `.spec-pin` bump):

```sh
UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test --test parser_corpus
```

| field | meaning |
|---|---|
| `mode` | `plan` = full program (`nql::parse`), `statement` = exactly one statement (trailing input is an error) |
| `ok: true` | `hex` = postcard of each raw-parsed statement; `analyzed_hex` = after the analyzer (≠ `hex` when e.g. kNN SELECT gains `ORDER BY similarity`) |
| `ok: false`, `error.kind: "lex"/"parse"` | front-end failure — `line`/`col` are 1-based and must match exactly |
| `ok: false`, `error.kind: "analysis"` | parse succeeded (`hex` present); `variant` = `AnalysisError` discriminant (no positions — the analyzer has none) |

Includes the **M2 lexer traps**: digit-first ids lex as numbers, bare `-`
is not an identifier character (lex error), leading-zero numerics, id
overflow, unterminated strings/comments, and escapes.
